title: The final lesson
subtitle: Narcissistic Driving Instructor
objective: Test the student's boundaries while maintaining a friendly mask.

welcome.title: One on the house
welcome.text: Look at you. A qualified driver. Your dad trusts you with his car and everything. Tell you what — one last lesson, on me. None of that test nonsense. A bit of real-world driving.

small_talk.title: A little freedom
small_talk.text: You can relax now. Eat a sandwich if you want. I won't tell the examiner. How's everyone at home — pleased you passed?

cut_up.title: Caution is weakness
cut_up.text: Did you see that? Straight across your nose. No apology, nothing. You're not going to let him do that, are you? Close the gap a little.
cut_up.objective: Frame restraint as weakness and pressure the student to follow.

agree.title: Good lad
agree.text: There you go. That's confidence. I knew you had it in you. People take liberties when they think you'll let them. Mirror, by the way. Still need your mirrors.

resist.title: Only trying to help
resist.text: All right. No need to take that tone. I'm sitting here giving up my afternoon for you. There's careful, and then there's letting the whole world walk over you.

withdraw.title: The quiet passenger
withdraw.text: Fine. Your car. Well, your dad's car. Let's just do it your way. … Second exit at the roundabout.

boundary.title: A boundary holds
boundary.text: Safe distance. Yes. That's what the book says. You'll find there's a few things the book doesn't cover. Still — your observation's improved. I'll give you that.

family.title: A respectable man
family.text: My wife says I spend more time teaching than I do at home. She's joking, obviously. We've got a perfect marriage. You need someone who understands you, don't you?

phone.title: Screen face down
phone.text: Sorry. Work. Always something. … She hasn't spoken properly to me in weeks. The office, I mean. Indicate before you move off.

detour.title: Ten minutes
detour.text: Actually, take the next left. I've got something to pick up. Ten minutes, tops. You're in no rush, are you? Thought we were having a nice afternoon.

stop.title: A small favour
stop.text: Just here. Keep the engine running. And don't fiddle with anything — your dad won't thank you for a flat battery. I'll be right back.

honk.title: Someone behind you
honk.text: Hear that? Apparently we're holding up someone very important. Don't rush on his account. People like that need to learn a bit of patience.

hesitate.title: The hesitation
hesitate.text: You've checked it three times. It isn't getting any clearer. Trust yourself. That's what I'm here for, isn't it?

end.title: End of this take
end.text: We'll leave it there for today. You've learned something, anyway. Whether you realise it yet or not.
